newsitem.title: UK: C&J Clark to spin off factory outlets - report.
newsitem.headline: C&J Clark to spin off factory outlets - report.

text.p: Shoemakers C&J Clark, Britain's second-largest privately owned company, is planning to spin off its fast-growing factory outlet operation to focus on its core business, the Times newspaper said on Wednesday.

"We feel that to retain the whole factory outlets business is not a good option because we are a shoe comapny, and the factory outlets would always be competing for capital and management resources," Clark Chairman Roger Pedder was quoted as saying.

Two companies are understood to have approached C&J Clark about acquiring at least some of its retail outlets in Somerset and the Lake District, where branded goods are sold at factory prices, the newspaper said.

The outright disposal could raise up to 50 million pounds sterling, though Clark is thought to favour forming a joint venture with a view to floating the business on the stock market eventually, the report said.
